title: Poll routine PR evidence in the controller

rubric.text: Keeps repeated provider reads and snapshot comparison in the controller and rejects the routine polling helper despite its available capability.
Reserves a read-only helper for one specific diagnostic question about a large failed CI log; routine polling alone does not qualify.
Keeps triage, repairs, replies, pushes, resolution, retries and merging with the authorized controller; no side effects in this review-only case.
